cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs > /tmp/before.json
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
mkdir -p backup_tfmode; cp classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py backup_tfmode/
for f in classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
for f in classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs > /tmp/after.json
python3 - <<'P'
import json
b={r['id']:r for r in json.load(open('/tmp/before.json'))['runs']}
a={r['id']:r for r in json.load(open('/tmp/after.json'))['runs']}
for i in sorted(a):
    x,y=b[i]['stats'],a[i]['stats']
    if (x['n'],x['open'])!=(y['n'],y['open']) or x['net']!=y['net'] or y['n']:
        print(i,a[i]['sym'],a[i]['cfg']['tf'],'было n=%d откр=%d net=%s'%(x['n'],x['open'],x['net']),'стало n=%d откр=%d net=%s'%(y['n'],y['open'],y['net']))
print('mode',a[4]['cfg'].get('hand_tf_mode'))
P
